thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — service=redwood-runtime-canary sev=SEV2 — summary=\"canary latency spike after deploy\". Incident INC-2026-314. Metrics link: https://telemetry/redwood/incidents/INC-2026-314

samir: I kicked the canary deploy v2026-03-14-1 at ~09:10 UTC to 10%. Warmups looked ok on my local checks, didn't expect this.

emma: Ack — I'm on-call. Pulling traces / logs now.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-314 created and routed to oncall (emma). PagerDuty: https://pd.example/INC-2026-314

olivia: Seeing 95p latency jump 220ms -> 1.2s on canary nodes, error rate up ~4.8%. Affected endpoints: /v1/complete, /v1/chat. Canary pool: eu-west1.

marta: Any infra/kernel changes shipped with that build? samir?

samir: Only change was model-server binary bump + kernel selector tweaks (smaller codepath). Deploy command I ran: `deploy release v2026-03-14-1 --targets=canary --percent=10`. No infra config changes.

emma: If canary is impacting customers we should rollback canary only. raj, pls standby for escalation.

raj: Standby. If emma wants a rollback I can execute.

emma: Let's do scoped rollback for canary. I'll run rollback now.

emma: Command:
```
deploy rollback runtime-canary --to v2026-03-13 --scope=canary
```

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for runtime-canary -> target version v2026-03-13. Rolling back 2/5 canary pods... logs: `k8s: evict pod runtime-canary-7f6d9` `kubectl apply ...` ETA ~2m.

olivia: Quick log sample from failing pod: `ERROR api: request handler: Failed to select kernel for attention op: unsupported f16 layout -> fallback -> OOM -> timeout`. Looks like kernel selection path is hitting an unsupported layout on eu-west GPUs.

marta: That matches — driver in eu-west1 doesn't support the new f16 kernel layout. ML-infra change probably needed.

pagerduty-bot: INC-2026-314 acknowledged by emma at 09:16 UTC.

samir: Rollback status: 3/5 pods now on v2026-03-13, 2 still draining. Seeing reduced 5xx on those nodes.

emma: Customer impact summary (initial): peak error rate ~8% for dedicated tenants in eu-west1, interactive chat sessions experiencing 504s/timeouts. No billing/job data loss reported. Affected customers: a small subset of EU tenants.

raj: Putting a temporary edge route weight change to reduce traffic to canary while rollback completes: `edgectl route update --backend=runtime-canary --weight=0.1` — applying.

deploy-bot: rollback complete. All canary pods running v2026-03-13. Healthchecks: 200/200.

olivia: Metrics trending back to baseline within ~45s after rollback. 95p back to ~250ms, error rate down to normal.

marta: Recommend blocking v2026-03-14-1 from promotion to staging/prod until ML infra reproduces and we fix kernel selector. Assign samir + ml-infra.

samir: Will open a revert PR and repro on test rig. tagging @ml-infra for driver/kernel verification.

emma: I'll keep monitoring for 30m and then hand off to raj for postmortem and follow-ups.

raj: Taking over triage/follow-up. I'll draft an initial incident note and own RCA. Will sync with samir and marta.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-314 resolved by emma at 09:25 UTC. Resolution: canary rollback to v2026-03-13 restored baseline. Duration ~13m.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident thread closed. Actions queued: [1] block release v2026-03-14-1 from further rollouts, [2] RCA owner=raj (48h postmortem), [3] reproduce failure in ml-infra test harness, owner=samir/marta.

emma: thanks everyone. will follow up in the RCA doc. :thumbsup:
